name: Face Recognition
description: Recognises enrolled people on the device: SCRFD finds the face and its five landmarks, ArcFace turns the aligned crop into a 512-D template, and a cosine scan against the on-device gallery names it. Enrollment and removal go over MQTT. No face image ever leaves the camera.
description_zh: 端侧人脸识别：SCRFD 检出人脸与五点关键点，ArcFace 将对齐后的人脸编码为 512 维特征，与设备本地人脸库做余弦比对得出身份。注册与删除通过 MQTT 下发。人脸影像不出设备。
author: Seeed Studio
